description: UN M49 standard country or area codes for statistical use — the region map the fNRB multi-national fallback reads. A6.4-AMT-009 v01.0 Table 2 publishes fNRB values for three regions (Asia, Latin America, Sub-Saharan Africa) and names no country list for them; this file is the cited geoscheme that decides which region a country sits in. Geography only — the fNRB values themselves live in calculators/data/fnrb/countries.json (Amy's ruling (3)(a), 2026-09-21).
coverage: Every country or area the UN M49 English table publishes — 248 rows, all of which carry an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. This is wider than the calculator's 186-country selector on purpose (the coverage rule: cover every entity the primary source provides). A country absent from this file would get the same honest refusal as a country outside the three tool regions; a coverage test asserts that no selectable country is absent.
method: Read from the UNSD M49 overview page's English table (columns: Region Code/Name, Sub-region Code/Name, Intermediate Region Code/Name, Country or Area, M49 Code, ISO-alpha3). The three A6.4-AMT-009 Table 2 regions are DERIVED from those codes, never hand-listed: Sub-Saharan Africa = M49 sub-region 202; Latin America = M49 sub-region 419 ('Latin America and the Caribbean'); Asia = M49 region 142. A country matching none of the three carries toolRegion: null.

sub-saharan-africa.label: Sub-Saharan Africa
sub-saharan-africa.note: M49 sub-region 202 of region 002 (Africa). Northern Africa (M49 015) is NOT included.

latin-america.label: Latin America
latin-america.note: M49 sub-region 419 of region 019 (Americas). Northern America (M49 021) is NOT included. AMT-009 Table 2 names the region 'Latin America'; M49's nearest published grouping is 419, which also carries the Caribbean.

asia.label: Asia
asia.note: M49 region 142, all five sub-regions (Central, Eastern, South-eastern, Southern, Western Asia).

GBR.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

HKG.name: China, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

SGS.name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

notes: Geography only. This file carries no fNRB number and no methodology parameter.
The three tool regions are derived from M49 codes at generation time, so a UN revision to a country's region moves it here rather than in code.

A6.4-AMT-009 Table 2 names 'Latin America'; the geoscheme's published grouping is 'Latin America and the Caribbean' (419). The tool publishes no country list, so 419 is the map used, and the report names it.
